statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. The latest verified Nasdaq futures quote returned to the overnight low zone after an earlier rebound, while oil and Treasury yields remain elevated.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. A stronger block would require repeated low-zone extension or further failed retracements; durable two-sided recovery would reduce Tail.
headline: Failed NQ rebound restores elevated Tail risk into the European open
body: Nasdaq futures were 29,038 at 06:22 UTC, almost exactly the prior 29,037.5 overnight low after an earlier rebound toward 29,089. Brent near $95.7, the U.S. 10-year yield near 4.81%, and sharp Asian equity losses reinforce downside pressure, but repeated no-retracement extension is not yet independently verified.

lookbackSummary: From 07:00 UTC September 1 through 06:00 UTC September 2, Tail rose from 19 to a 47 peak during the U.S. selloff, dropped to watch after late-session mean reversion, climbed back to 31 near overnight lows, then eased to 23 when NQ rebounded toward the overnight high.
outlookSummary: Immediate risk centers on the European cash-open handoff after NQ returned to the overnight low zone. Later checkpoints are ADP, the U.S. cash open, Factory Orders and EIA data, then the Beige Book and Broadcom. Future Tail escalation remains conditional on persistent extension and failed retracements.

forecast.analysis: The freshest independently verified Nasdaq futures quote was 29,038 at 06:22 UTC, back near the prior 29,037.5 overnight low after an earlier rebound. Oil above $95 and a 10-year yield near 4.81% reinforce downside pressure, but repeated no-retracement extension is not yet verified.

forecast.analysis: By the second European hour, continued lows with failed rebounds would preserve elevated Tail. Two-sided rotation or a reclaim of the overnight range would favor faster decay toward watch.

forecast.analysis: If Europe fails to extend the overnight decline, Tail falls back to watch despite severe macro stress. A fresh session-low break with shallow recovery would invalidate that easing path.
Pre-ADP positioning can raise volatility without establishing Tail. Watch-level Tail assumes no persistent directional extension before the 12:15 UTC labor-market release.
ADP at 12:15 UTC is a major volatility checkpoint. Elevated Tail requires repeated post-release extension or failed retracements; surprise magnitude alone does not establish a pathological path.
drivers: ADP National Employment Report at 12:15 UTC

forecast.analysis: Into the U.S. cash open, Tail approaches the top of elevated only if post-ADP direction persists through the opening auction with shallow pullbacks. A strong opening reversal would reduce it.
Factory Orders at 14:00 UTC and EIA petroleum data at 14:30 UTC overlap with early cash trading. Tail stays elevated only if those catalysts reinforce a one-way NQ path with failed retracements.
After the opening and data cluster, elevated Tail assumes directional efficiency persists. Visible two-sided price discovery and meaningful retracements would push the score lower.
Mid-session Tail remains elevated only under continued extension near session extremes. Rotation back through the morning range would favor watch rather than a sustained block state.
Absent persistent extreme-holding, the early afternoon base case returns to watch. Oil and yields can keep Stress high even if NQ mean reversion is functioning.
The 18:00 UTC Beige Book can reopen repricing risk. Elevated Tail is conditional on a directional rates-and-equities response that produces repeated NQ extension rather than brief volatility.
drivers: Federal Reserve Beige Book at 18:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: In the first post-Beige hour, Tail remains just elevated only if repricing persists. Orderly retracements and stabilizing yields would return the path toward watch.

Around the U.S. cash close, Tail is elevated conditionally because Broadcom reports after the bell. The scheduled result is not assumed; the relevant checkpoint is whether index futures develop persistent directional repricing.

Broadcom's 21:00 UTC earnings call is an index-sensitive semiconductor checkpoint. Elevated Tail assumes any verified repricing becomes persistent with shallow pullbacks; a two-sided reaction would reduce it.
After the Broadcom call, Tail remains elevated only if after-hours NQ repricing extends repeatedly. Stabilization or meaningful reversal would move the regime back toward watch.
Late U.S. after-hours risk returns to watch if corporate repricing stabilizes. Persistent oil and yield pressure can keep Stress elevated without proving mean-reversion failure.
Early Asia hours are conditionally watch-level. Tail would rise only if the new regional session confirms the U.S. direction with fresh NQ extreme-holding and weak retracements.
Tail stays at watch if Asia remains two-sided. A synchronized equity decline with NQ holding near lows would be the main escalation path.
As Asian liquidity deepens, watch-level Tail assumes retracements remain available. Persistent downside extension across regional equities and NQ would raise the score.
Late Asia remains near the top of watch because oil and yields may continue to transmit inflation stress. Tail still requires observed one-way NQ structure rather than the macro backdrop alone.
Ahead of the European handoff, Tail remains watch unless overnight NQ develops fresh extreme-holding or repeated failed retracements. Scheduled U.S. data later in the day primarily supports Stress.
The final Asia hour stays watch-level under a balanced path. A fresh directional break would need confirmation from retracement failure before materially raising Tail.

Approaching the next European open, Tail is at the top of watch unless the overnight path has become persistently one-way. Later U.S. claims, Waller and ISM Services remain conditional checkpoints, not observed outcomes.
drivers: Later U.S. labor and Fed checkpoints

forecastDetail.comment: A failed overnight rebound returned NQ toward the prior low; aligned oil and yields lift Tail, but repeated extension is not yet verified.
Elevated Tail depends on low-zone persistence and shallow rebounds through the European open; durable recovery would reduce it.
Continued failed rebounds would preserve elevated Tail, while two-sided European rotation would weaken the directional case.
Tail returns to watch if Europe does not extend the decline; a fresh low with shallow recovery would re-escalate risk.
Pre-ADP volatility alone does not establish Tail; watch assumes no persistent extension before the release.
ADP can lift Stress sharply; elevated Tail requires actual repeated post-release extension or failed retracements.
